boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Trinity rituals and recurring community observances, including one discontinued historical tradition.

cards.title: Tower Climb
cards.subtitle: Murchison Tower • first-year orientation and senior sendoff
cards.notes: Climb Murchison Tower during orientation or the senior tradition when it is scheduled; use the official program details for participation guidance.
cards.short_summary: A 297-step bookend: students climb on arrival and again near graduation.
cards.evidence_claim: Trinity documents Tower Climb as a first-year orientation rite and a second climb for seniors days before graduation.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled through orientation and senior programming; confirm current participation details with Trinity.

cards.title: Christmas Vespers
cards.subtitle: Margarite B. Parker Chapel • first Sunday of December
cards.notes: Attend the annual lessons, carols, and candlelight service in Parker Chapel, then continue to the Christmas on Oakmont gathering.
cards.short_summary: A candlelit Trinity holiday service documented back to a 1925 Mirage reference.
cards.evidence_claim: Trinity lists Christmas Vespers as an annual tradition featuring lessons, carols, candlelight, and Trinity musicians.
cards.source_title: Events and News | Chapel and Spiritual Life | Trinity University
cards.access_notes: Annual event; the Chapel lists it for the first Sunday of December in Parker Chapel.

cards.title: Christmas on Oakmont
cards.subtitle: Oakmont Court • follows Christmas Vespers
cards.notes: After Vespers, follow the gathering to Oakmont Court and visit the hosted outdoor stops announced by Trinity for that year.
cards.short_summary: A post-Vespers Oakmont Court tradition dating at least to the 1970s.
cards.evidence_claim: Trinity says Christmas on Oakmont follows Vespers and has Tigers visit Oakmont Court for treats, music, and community gathering.
cards.source_title: Trinity Announces 2023 Holiday Festivities | Trinity University
cards.access_notes: Held immediately after Vespers; confirm the current year’s event listing before going.

cards.title: Trinity Christmas Concert
cards.subtitle: Laurie Auditorium • annual holiday weekend
cards.notes: Check Trinity’s holiday listing for the performance date, then attend the combined student-ensemble concert in Laurie Auditorium.
cards.short_summary: Student choir, orchestra, wind, handbell, and smaller ensembles share a public holiday concert.
cards.evidence_claim: Trinity’s 2023 holiday announcement describes its 29th annual Christmas Concert with multiple Trinity student ensembles.
cards.source_title: Trinity Announces 2023 Holiday Festivities | Trinity University
cards.access_notes: The cited 2023 event was free with no tickets required; verify the current year’s arrangements.

cards.title: Midnight Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Mabee Dining Hall • reading day before finals
cards.notes: Watch Residential Life and dining announcements during finals season, then join the late-night breakfast when the campus event is offered.
cards.short_summary: Faculty, staff, and leaders serve a finals-eve breakfast beginning just before midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Trinity documents Midnight Breakfast as a reading-day tradition at Mabee Hall, with faculty, leadership, and staff serving students.
cards.access_notes: Historically held at 11:59 p.m. on a reading day; confirm current finals-week scheduling and dining access.

cards.entity_name: City of San Antonio Martin Luther King Jr. March
cards.title: Trinity at the MLK March
cards.subtitle: San Antonio • Martin Luther King Jr. Week
cards.notes: Join Trinity’s announced group for the city march, following the University’s current meeting, transportation, and accessibility guidance.
cards.short_summary: Students, faculty, staff, and alumni participate together in San Antonio’s annual MLK observance.
cards.evidence_claim: Trinity calls its community participation in the City of San Antonio Martin Luther King Jr. March an annual tradition.
cards.source_title: Programs & Initiatives | Student Inclusion and Belonging | Trinity University
cards.access_notes: Participation details vary by year; use Student Inclusion and Belonging announcements for current logistics.

cards.entity_name: Martin Luther King Jr. Commemorative Lecture
cards.title: MLK Commemorative Lecture
cards.subtitle: Trinity University • Martin Luther King Jr. Week
cards.notes: Look for the annual speaker announcement and attend the campus lecture honoring racial and social justice work.
cards.short_summary: An annual Trinity and San Antonio MLK Commission lecture centered on the civil-rights leader’s legacy.
cards.evidence_claim: Trinity identifies the Martin Luther King Jr. Commemorative Lecture as an annual program with the San Antonio MLK Commission.
cards.source_title: Programs & Initiatives | Student Inclusion and Belonging | Trinity University
cards.access_notes: Annual event; consult Trinity’s current MLK Week information for speaker, venue, and access details.

cards.entity_name: City of San Antonio Cesar E. Chavez March
cards.title: Trinity at the César E. Chávez March
cards.subtitle: San Antonio • César E. Chávez Day
cards.notes: Follow Student Inclusion and Belonging updates to participate with Trinity’s group in the city’s César E. Chávez observance.
cards.short_summary: A recurring Trinity community presence at San Antonio’s César E. Chávez March.
cards.evidence_claim: Trinity says it annually honors César E. Chávez through participation in the San Antonio march.
cards.source_title: Programs & Initiatives | Student Inclusion and Belonging | Trinity University
cards.access_notes: Participation details vary by year; confirm Trinity’s current meeting and transportation information.

cards.title: César E. Chávez Commemorative Lecture
cards.subtitle: Trinity University • César E. Chávez Day
cards.notes: Check the annual campus calendar for the lecture, then attend the program that accompanies Trinity’s César E. Chávez observance.
cards.short_summary: A recurring campus lecture paired with Trinity’s annual César E. Chávez Day programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Trinity states that it annually honors César E. Chávez with a public lecture and participation in the San Antonio march.
cards.source_title: Programs & Initiatives | Student Inclusion and Belonging | Trinity University
cards.access_notes: Annual programming; verify the current lecture date, venue, and attendance arrangements through Trinity.

cards.title: Founders’ Day
cards.subtitle: Trinity history • discontinued in the early 1970s
cards.notes: Treat this as a historical tradition: explore Trinity’s account of the Tehuacana commemorations rather than expecting an active campus event.
cards.short_summary: Former April 20 observances connected the community to Trinity’s 1869 Tehuacana founding.
cards.evidence_claim: Trinity documents Founders’ Day celebrations around April 20 and says official mentions largely disappeared by the early 1970s.
cards.access_notes: Discontinued historical tradition; no current participation is implied.
